title: build validate takes at most one build id: a flag (there is no --all and no --json) or a second word is an unknown argument, exit 2
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build of every layer, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-13, build validate). The command has one optional positional, the build id, and no flag: no argument already means every build, and there is no machine-readable output yet. A word that starts with a dash, or a second positional, is `JITSO REJECTED: unknown argument "<x>"` on stderr, exit 2, nothing on stdout, with the same text the launch command gives. The oracle has no `build validate` (and the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs the command's output FAILS on it.
